description: This file implements OpenID Connect client logic, including provider discovery, user info retrieval, ID token handling, and cryptographic verification, for the golang.org/x/oauth2 package.

classes.name: Provider
classes.description: Represents an OpenID Connect server's configuration, including issuer, endpoints, supported algorithms, and raw claims.

classes.name: UserInfo
classes.description: Contains claims returned by the OpenID Connect userinfo endpoint, such as subject, email, and profile.

classes.name: IDToken
classes.description: Represents an OpenID Connect ID token with methods for claim extraction and access token verification.

methods.name: Claims
methods.description: Unmarshals raw JSON claims into a provided struct.

methods.name: UserInfo
methods.description: Queries the userinfo endpoint to retrieve user claims.

methods.name: VerifyAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies that the hash of the access token matches the hash in the ID token.
